Some examples I might suggest:

  • Arduino anything is pretty interesting. Even the basic "make a light blink" circuits can be informative if you've never made one before.
  • Binary math and counting. How do they show negative numbers in binary? What is a floating point? Why does hexadecimal work so nicely with binary?
  • Logic in terms of components. Look at how you can build a simple adder out of AND OR NOR XOR gates.
  • How do they build semiconductors anyway? What IS a semiconductor? What's the difference between NPN and PNP transistors? How many kinds of diodes are there?
  • What makes a set of instructions Turing-complete?
